products.name: Calm Cove Chamomile & Lavender Tea
products.description: A soothing blend of organic Egyptian chamomile blossoms and French lavender buds designed to ease tension and promote deep sleep.
products.directions: Steep 1-2 teaspoons in freshly boiled water (95°C / 203°F) for 5-7 minutes. Enjoy before bedtime.
products.cautions: Avoid if you have an allergy to ragweed or daisy family plants. Consult your physician if pregnant or nursing.

products.name: Harbour Sunrise Citrus Green Tea
products.description: An invigorating morning blend of high-altitude Sencha green tea with dried organic orange peel, lemongrass, and ginger.
products.directions: Steep 1 teaspoon in 80°C (175°F) water for 2-3 minutes. Do not overheat to preserve delicate tea polyphenols.
products.cautions: Contains mild natural caffeine from green tea. Not recommended right before sleep.

products.name: Deep Root Turmeric & Ginger Blend
products.description: A potent warming infusion combining golden turmeric root, spicy ginger, black pepper, and cinnamon to combat systemic inflammation.
benefits: Supports joint mobility and post-exercise recovery
products.directions: Simmer or steep 1-2 teaspoons in boiling water for 8-10 minutes. Can be paired with warm oat milk for a golden latte.
products.cautions: Consult doctor if taking blood thinners or gallstone medication.

products.name: Ashwagandha Tranquility Drops
products.description: High-concentration hydro-ethanolic extract of KSM-66 certified organic Ashwagandha root to modulate adrenal fatigue and cortisol response.
products.directions: Take 1 full dropper (approx. 30 drops / 1ml) directly under the tongue or dissolved in water/juice 1-2 times daily.
products.cautions: Do not consume during pregnancy. Discontinue 2 weeks prior to surgery.

products.name: Lion's Mane Clarity Tincture
products.description: Dual-extracted (hot water + alcohol) fruiting body Lion's Mane mushroom extract formulated to stimulate Nerve Growth Factor (NGF).
ingredients: Organic Hericium Erinaceus (Lion's Mane) Fruiting Body Extract
benefits: Enhances mental clarity and sustained focus
products.directions: Take 1-2 droppers in the morning with coffee, tea, or a smoothie.
products.cautions: Consult a healthcare practitioner if taking diabetic or blood clotting medications.

products.name: Elderberry Immune Shield Syrup
products.description: Handcrafted botanical immune syrup made with wildcrafted European black elderberries, raw wildflower honey, and cloves.
benefits: Seasonal defense against colds and flu
High in Vitamin C and flavonoids
products.directions: Adults: 1 tablespoon daily for maintenance, up to 3 times daily during acute seasonal challenges. Children (over 1 yr): 1 teaspoon.
products.cautions: Contains raw honey — not suitable for infants under 12 months.

products.name: Calendula Rescue Salve
products.description: An ultra-gentle, all-natural skin remedy infused with whole organic Calendula petals, cold-pressed jojoba oil, and unrefined beeswax.
benefits: Deeply nourishes chapped skin and dry patches
Soothes eczema, minor cuts, and burns
products.directions: Warm a pea-sized amount between fingers and gently massage onto affected dry areas. Reapply as needed.
products.cautions: For external use only. Test a small patch on inner forearm first.

products.name: Arnica Muscle Recovery Balm
products.description: Fast-acting topical botanical balm featuring wildcrafted Arnica Montana, menthol crystals, and wintergreen for tired joints and muscles.
benefits: Relieves tension in stiff necks, backs, and shoulders
products.directions: Massage vigorously into sore joints or muscles after physical exertion.
products.cautions: External use only. Do not apply to broken skin, wounds, or mucous membranes.
